## QVC: External Code Review

This project uses QVC (QA of Vebe Coding) for external code review.
QVC is an external overseer that finds bugs your AI Agent missed in self-review.

### Commands
- When the user says **"fix qvc"** or **"qvc tasks"**: read `.qvc/tasks/pending.md` and fix all listed issues
- When the user says **"qvc status"**: read `.qvc/tasks/status.json` and report task state
- When the user says **"scan with qvc"**: run `qvc scan .` and process the results

### After fixing issues
Report to the user in 3-5 lines:
1. How many issues QVC found
2. How many you fixed
3. Which ones were structural blind spots (AI self-review could not detect them)

### Important
- QVC never modifies code itself — it only reports issues
- The `.qvc/tasks/pending.md` file is the handoff point between QVC and you
- Fix issues, then the user can re-scan to verify
